target: Re-review of the board-access cutover features after post-round-8 changes: Google OAuth callback, /system routes, admin-secret handling, CORS allowlist, SameSite=Lax cookies, embedded migrations
authority: Workspace Owner has implicit access. Every other actor needs active project membership plus an explicit board grant. Only the Owner administers board grants. A Manager may create a board without an automatic grant.
mandatoryCriteria: Every mounted board-derived read filters by current board access before pagination, counts, title/body delivery, or receipt replay, including board snapshots, cards, search, My Tasks, activity, inbox, images, imports and trash.

Every mounted board-derived write reauthorizes current board access in the same transaction and serializes with grant removal, including cards, comments, images, imports, columns, archive/reopen, trash and notification read state.
No route silently falls back to project-only access if the board-grants migration is missing. Malformed or legacy records fail closed for non-Owners.
Revoked and never-granted actors receive non-enumerating private not-found responses and cannot recover board IDs, names, titles, counts, links, assets or saved receipt data.
Mounted-handler tests on isolated PostgreSQL cover Owner, Manager, Member, Viewer, no grant, revoked grant, sibling project, replay and relevant races; Node and Worker paths are reviewed.

Real identity: Google callback validates state, rejects unverified or missing email_verified, never issues a session on failure, and no route issues email-only sessions in a deployed (Worker/production) runtime. dev-login is unreachable when deployed.

No credential or secret has a public default outside NODE_ENV=test; /system/status, /system/migrate and existing-account dev-login are closed (403/404) without a configured secret of 32+ characters; comparison is timing-safe.
Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure off localhost; credentialed CORS is allowed only for localhost and the explicit CORS_ORIGIN list (no wildcard hosting-domain suffixes).
embedded-migrations.ts matches database/migrations/*.sql exactly, so the Worker and Node runtimes apply identical schema including board grants (0007, 0008).
Current source, migrations, route files, shared helpers, contracts and tests are included in an exact manifest and a fresh independent review passes all BACKEND_REVIEW_GATE.md rules.
exclusions: Hosted deployment, real Google, and live-user data are not authorized. Real-provider behavior is out of scope and must be listed as a known limitation, not scored as proven.
